name: central-muse-adapter
transport: stdio JSONL (JSON-RPC 2.0, one frame per line)
frameCapNote: Measured 2026-11-17 across live echo + meta turns: largest single frame ~2 KB (session objects with sourceRange). 8 MiB inherits the Codex cap: ~4000x headroom, close-on-oversize proven by unit test, never partial parse.

schemaProvenance.reason: Schema exported offline on 2026-11-21 from installed muse 1.4.24 (stable surface, schemaVersion 1; identical 75 methods / 47 notifications / 2 requests / 39 error codes as 1.4.20+1.4.23 captures, ApprovalCuaBrowser def still present). The serve handshake was then exercised LIVE on 1.4.24 via the echo provider: initialize (+initialized notify) -> session/start (workspaceRoot composed, UUIDv7 commandId enforced server-side) -> turn/start -> turn/completed with session/tokenUsage + session/contextUsage. Approval/userInput request+decide flows are schema-captured but NOT live-exercised (echo never asks).
schemaProvenance.schemaSource: muse schema generate-json-schema (stable, captured 2026-11-21, kept outside the repo)
schemaProvenance.liveHandshakeVerified: 1.4.24, 2026-11-21: echo turn flow (initialize/initialized/session-start/turn-start/turn-completed/tokenUsage/contextUsage); approval/request + userInput/request + decide/answer not exercised

policies.oversizeFrame: close transport, require reconciliation, never parse partial event
policies.secretHandling: logs and request errors redact token/secret/authorization material; no tokens or env in durable outbox
policies.modelMismatch: requested/observed model mismatch is a capability error, never silent fallback
policies.usageSource: usage is harvested from session/tokenUsage (usage/cumulative/totalTokens siblings) and session/contextUsage notifications, not from turn/completed (which carries terminal status only)
